name: aqar-factory-property
description: Aqar Factory — static site with Vercel serverless functions and Edge Middleware. No build step for the site itself. @aws-sdk/* is used by api/media-upload.js to talk to Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible) for admin file uploads; the rest are used only by api/prerender.js (headless-render a page into static HTML) and middleware.js (read the cached result from Vercel Blob).
